assessments.reasoning: Paragraph 7 identifies attempted modification through a non-const lvalue and anchors the qualifier to the object's defining type. This is an explicit undefined-behavior statement in the draft.

challenge.method: Contrasted the paragraph with the following example of a const volatile clock and the different modifiable-lvalue constraint on an assignment to a const-qualified expression.
challenge.results: The statement concerns a const-defined object and attempted modification through a non-const access path. A qualified access path to an otherwise mutable object and hardware modification are separate cases.

limitations: The rule concerns modification of a const-defined object. Qualifying an access path to an object and hardware storage or protection are separate questions.
Scope is the exact N3220 C2y working draft. Published ISO text and observed implementation behavior require separate evidence.
